metadata.topic: A Guardian Rises: arrival in the Tower
metadata.description: After completing the opening mission, holding Continue takes the Guardian to Tower North in the Last City.
metadata.previous_state: Continue left the end-of-mission screens but the game loaded a stand-in lunar map, then the Tower stalled on its loading screen.
metadata.current_state: The Tower loads and the Guardian stands in Tower North with the HUD up.
metadata.remaining_issue: The story cinematic between the mission and the Tower is skipped by a stand-in mapping; Tower characters and vendors untested; advancement tab empty; values synthetic.
metadata.next_task: Serve the story cinematic before the Tower; check movement and vendors in the Tower.
metadata.audio: game audio only, one emulator port; music may be present
